rationale: Brian appears as both a zero_source and thin page - highest overlap. It's a major Python-based neural simulator widely used in computational neuroscience. Research will yield content for two wiki pages and establish TVB's connection to the broader neural simulation ecosystem.

BrainDecode appears in both zero_source and thin pages. It's a leading EEG deep learning library. Combined with PyTorch Geometric Temporal (for temporal GNNs on brain data), this establishes TVB's position in the EEG/ML space.

FieldTrip is one of the most widely used EEG/MEG toolboxes in neuroscience research - critical gap. Also ties to Von Economo Atlas (both are used together for source analysis). Combined research establishes TVB as part of established EEG analysis workflows.
queries: FieldTrip toolbox EEG MEG source analysis
